question: What ritual act must follow immediately after completing the invocation of the goddess?
premises: The invocation is performed in the manner described.
The goddess's vital breaths are the object of the next act.
The practitioner is instructed to establish them.
inference: After performing the invocation, one should establish the vital breaths of the goddess.
plain_english: Having thus performed the invocation, one should establish the vital breaths of the goddess.
